name: How to Catch Absolutely Nothing in Space
summary:
Good day User! You received a special promotion and now are stucked here on this planet! But don't worry, you can use your special entity capturing device, also known as Fishing Gear, to catch a fish and let the promiotion end!

In "How to Catch Absolutely Nothing in Space", you'll have to use your fishing gear to catch a fish from the galactic pond. But beware! Doing so you might find Planet-Destroying Buttons, Space-Distorting Rackets and Alien Creatures!
